content_sections.heading: About the Centre
content_sections.text: Karnatak University is at Pavate Nagar, Dharwad. The recruitment is conducted by its Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation Board (PMEB) for the Research Centre for Women's Studies (RCWS), whose project is funded by the University Grants Commission (UGC), New Delhi. Selected candidates work exclusively on this UGC-funded project at RCWS, Karnatak University, Dharwad.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice announces 6 posts in two units, and no category-wise break-up is printed.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice prints one essential qualification for both teaching posts, in two alternative routes: Route 1: Master degree in women studies with NET or KSET in Women's Studies or Equivalent / MA in Inter-disciplinary subjects related to MA in Women's studies (Faculty of Social Science) and Diploma in Women's Studies with NET or KSET in interdisciplinary subject. The Master Degree needs minimum 55% for GM and 50% for SC/ST, Cat-1 candidates. OR Route 2: Ph.D. in Women's Studies or Ph.D. in Inter-disciplinary subjects (Women's Based Studies) and Diploma in Women's Studies. Preference is given to candidates with a Ph.D. or NET/KSET in the relevant subject(s) with Diploma in Women's Studies, wherever applicable. The computer skill is shown by a valid certificate of a minimum one year Computer Training Course, or Advanced Diploma in Computer Applications, or Diploma in Computer Application, or Computer Operator for Programming Assistants Course, from a recognized Computer Centre or Institution. The post table lists one year experience as part of the qualification for Project Assistant, Office Assistant-cum-Computer Operator and Library Assistant. The covering notice says one year experience is preferred for these three posts. The notice prints no age relaxation. Eligibility of qualification and experience is determined as on the date of the selection process, and the qualification must be from a recognised University, Institution or board as applicable. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The posts are purely temporary and initially for a period of one year. The tenure may be extended, subject to satisfactory performance, satisfactory progress of the work, and the availability of funds with RCWS from UGC, New Delhi. Appointment is based on merit and roster and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or entitlement to housing, medical facilities, or other benefits available to regular University employees. Selected candidates must abide by the applicable rules, regulations, ordinances, statutes and Acts of the University, UGC and RCWS, as applicable from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Karnatak University Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice gives one line for both posts: "As per UGC-RCWS Requirements-Both Teaching and Research." Documentation and admission related works. Research project works, data collection and field works. Data processing and preparation of reports. Other project related works assigned by the Director. Office-related works and computer-related works. Data entry, data processing, documentation and preparation of reports. Other project-related works as assigned by the Director. Maintenance of the library books, office files, magazines and journals. Issuing and receiving the library books. Maintenance of project reports, internship reports and research reports etc., as assigned by the Director.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Karnatak University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The application form may be obtained in person from the Office of the Director, Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation Board (PMEB), Karnatak University, Dharwad, or downloaded from www.kud.ac.in . The last date for submission is 30 November 2026. Mention clearly the post applied for. A candidate who wants to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application with a separate fee for each. A presently employed applicant must submit a fresh application, otherwise it will not be considered. Fill the details at Sl. No. 1, 2, 3 and 7 of the form in both Kannada and English; overwriting is strictly not allowed. The fee is paid online only at SBI Collect, and the payment receipt/challan must be enclosed with the application. The notice gives these steps: Visit the University website www.kud.ac.in . Navigate to the online fee payment section. Select Karnatak University Fee (State Bank of India). Select Education Institution - Karnatak University - Karnataka State. Choose the payment category "Teaching and Non-Teaching Staff Application Processing Fee" and complete the payment. Teaching posts: selection is based on the prescribed UGC eligibility criteria and an interview conducted by the University. Non-teaching posts: selection is through an interview, subject to the prescribed eligibility requirements. The date and time of the interview will be communicated to eligible candidates through their registered e-mail IDs. The interview venue is Syndicate Hall, Administrative Building, K.U. Dharwad. Preference will be given to eligible and qualified in-service candidates who have served in Women's Studies at Karnatak University, Dharwad or any other Women's Study Department and Research Centre in any other University in Karnataka.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Recent passport size photograph. Copies of all necessary supporting documents, including attested true copies of certificates and statements of marks for the entries made in the form. Valid Caste Certificate (as per Government rules), where applicable. Copy of the authentic school leaving certificate in support of date of birth. Payment receipt/challan of the application processing fee. Employer's testimonial or service certificate where the applicant has been employed, as the form's references section describes.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Karnatak University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 temporary posts: 2 Assistant Professor, 1 Project Associate, 1 Project Assistant, 1 Office Assistant-cum-Computer Operator and 1 Library Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Library Assistant?
faq.answer: Library Assistant needs a pass in PUC with Computer Knowledge and one year experience. Project Assistant needs a degree in any discipline with one year experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor and Project Associate: below 50 years. Project Assistant, Office Assistant-cum-Computer Operator and Library Assistant: below 35 years. Age is counted as on the Notification date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Monthly consolidated salary is Rs.57,700 for Assistant Professor, Rs.38,000 for Project Associate, Rs.32,000 for Project Assistant, Rs.24,950 for Office Assistant-cum-Computer Operator and Rs.20,400 for Library Assistant.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: For teaching posts it is Rs.1000 for General and other eligible candidates and Rs.500 for SC/ST/Category-I. For non-teaching posts it is Rs.600 and Rs.300 respectively, paid online only at SBI Collect.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the duly filled form with supporting documents and the fee receipt by email to [email protected] or by post to The Director, PMEB, Karnatak University, Pavate Nagar, Dharwad - 580003.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Both teaching and non-teaching posts are filled through an interview conducted by the University. The interview date and time will be sent to eligible candidates on their registered e-mail IDs.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary, initially for one year, and give no right to claim regular appointment. The tenure may be extended subject to performance, progress of work and availability of UGC funds.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate who wishes to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application with a separate fee for each post.
